title: Netherite Torch Bow
description: This mod adds a Netherite upgrade version of the Torch Bow.
body:
This mod adds a Netherite upgrade version of the Torch Bow.
The Netherite Torch Bow has higher durability, double the projectile speed, better accuracy, and increased damage. When using a Torch Bundle as ammunition, it spreads horizontally like a Crossbow enchanted with Multishot, rather than spreading in a 3x3 grid. This improves the hit rate for players who enjoy using the Torch Bow as a weapon.

Known Bug: When using a Torch Bundle as ammunition, the additional arrows cannot be picked up. No fix has been found yet, so you can manually pick them up by right-clicking next to the arrows while holding the Netherite Torch Bow.
